notes.title: NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws v1.0.12 Update｜Pool Party Upgrade + Mid-Autumn Gift!
notes.notes:
V1.0.12 (2025-9-19) This Week's Updates✨
Hello everyone! Another week has flown by, and Miino is here with fresh updates!
Some of these features are already available in the Playtest branch, while the Demo version allows preview but not yet full use. We update daily, but we publish patch notes weekly—so here’s what’s new this week! 🐾
[hr][/hr]🆕 New Content
Pool Party Upgrade: New claw machine gameplay for grabbing gift boxes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/5ee9652e9f2229f544b8e409f1b9625d3497e0fd.png"]

New Leaderboard: Pool Party now tracks coin rewards from gift boxes.

New Mini-Game: Classic 2048 puzzle added for casual fun.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/afd103cb7a5d741a34c6b2d186f8ab2142978178.gif"]

New Decorations: 53 new items, including 8 scene lamps, 1 canopy, 1 wall, 1 window, 15 desks, 4 props, 12 lights, 10 keyboards, and more.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/35c9b7b44dccc6447e6549732f250e9ee3d9acd6.gif"]

Expanded Tutorials: More onboarding for Achievements, Daily Tasks, Study Room, White Noise, Music, Pool Party, and more.

Screenshot Tool: Added full-screen and desktop screenshot sharing support.


✨ About the Gift
🎁 Mid-Autumn Special Gift: Enter Meow Code → \[midautumn] to receive an exclusive Moon Lamp decoration!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/8fb9137bf9eeb77913f6a59ed6d4581a8381c5cf.gif"]

The Moon Lamp is a festive decorative item specifically designed to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Placing it on your desk creates a warm and festive atmosphere. Once redeemed, it will stay in your collection permanently — an item that commemorates this special moment! Moreover, it will be retained in the official version.
[hr][/hr]
﻿
⚙️ Improvements
Smarter screenshot capture (F12 now requires focus, with added close button).

Achievement timestamps now show correctly.

Improved “Boss Key” (F9 toggle on/off).

Enhanced headgear filter highlight.

UI/UX tweaks for white noise volume bar and exit behavior.

Better lighting for houses and devices.

New “Dual Screen” adjustments and smoother transitions.

Optimized saving and text animations.

Refined piggy bank sound effects.

﻿
[hr][/hr]
﻿
🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed baseball cap headgear model issues.

Fixed menu UI scaling issue at 1.42× with auto-hide.

Fixed mislinked cat command menu.

Fixed dragging/free mode quick-click issues.

Fixed decoration scaling click and persistence bugs.

Fixed hand clipping bug when no keyboard equipped.

Fixed Study Room invite and mini-mode overlaps.

Fixed flashing bug when moving house to screen edge.

Fixed multiple white noise issues across mini-modes.

Fixed Pool Party claw UI overlap and avatar blocking bug.

Fixed achievement completion bug in Playtest (300 gift boxes).
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all for your continued feedback and support! ❤️
We’re working hard to polish NoSlack Pets so every moment with Miino feels cozy, relaxing, and fun.

👉 Play the Demo or apply for Playtest now on Steam:
https://s.team/a/3714370


[hr][/hr]🙌 We Need Your Feedback!
The Demo is just the beginning—we’re polishing gameplay and experience every day. Please share your thoughts in the forums

Discord

x

or Bilibili, and help shape No Slack Pets! 💖



As a small 3-person indie team, every comment matters. Thanks to your support, we’ll keep improving and adding cozy surprises 🐾
[hr][/hr]🔮 Special Notes
Demo Version: Offers core gameplay, stable experience.

Playtest Version: For testing new features, may be unstable. Approved testers can invite 2 friends.

Progress: Coins, purchases, achievements, and levels will carry into the full release.

Headgears: With the exception of limited-event headgears, Demo/Playtest headgerar drops will not carry over due to Steam inventory restrictions.


[hr][/hr]
More test benefits and FAQs can be found here:

Test benefits and FAQs



❤️ A desktop pet that truly stays with you.
Relax with the sound of typing, study breaks, and cozy company.
✨ Download the Demo now and begin your journey of focus & companionship!

notes.title: [NoSlack pets：Lo-Fi Paws]V1.0.8 Update —Study Rooms & Piggy Bank System Arrive!
notes.notes:
V1.0.8 (2025-8-24)
Hello everyone! Here comes a brand-new update packed with new features, optimizations, and bug fixes. Let’s take a look!
[hr][/hr]✨ New Features📚 Study Room（Online）
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/6e728c8ac7747596bc6d64b04d662844ddba141c.png"]

You can now create or join an Online Study Room with your own custom name.

Study together with other players’ cats in real time.

When someone is busy studying and misses their headgear gift box, you can help them collect it—and they can help you too!

Track your help history, climb the leaderboard, and enjoy short chat interactions while focusing.
🐖 Piggy Bank System


[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45640874/ec6a184911766805aa8bfdaafb03a7066e7502fc.png"]


Based on community feedback, we’ve reworked the coin/XP collection system.

Miino Cat will now automatically store coins and XP in a piggy bank instead of dropping them around the screen.

You can collect them anytime by clicking the piggy bank.

Online Gain: +1 coin & +1 XP per minute while the game is running.

Offline Gain: +1 coin & +1 XP per 5 minutes, even when the game is closed.

Limit: The piggy bank stores up to 480 coins & 480 XP. Once full, it stops accumulating.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Optimizations
Headgear Collection now displays when and how each item was obtained.



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45640874/16578c0c7e8dec474b749d02cb5ab54a68a1fbd8.png"]

Moved the Follow button to the main menu.

Disabled most floating tooltips on items for a cleaner interface.

Reset some scene decoration prompts for better clarity.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where achievement unlock items could be obtained for free under certain conditions.

Fixed incorrect achievement display.

Fixed an issue where cats sitting on a window could get pushed off-screen when snapping the window to the top.

Fixed white noise settings being reset when switching to mini mode.

Fixed flickering when moving the cat house to the edge of the screen.

Fixed overlapping animations when entering via the Cat Bus after completing a Pomodoro in the Study Room.

Fixed issues with importing local music under certain conditions.

Fixed rooms not displaying correctly in rare cases.

Fixed abnormal white noise behavior when switching to the Cat Bus.
[hr][/hr]
That’s all for this update! 🎉 As always, thank you for your feedback and support—it helps us improve step by step. Keep sharing your thoughts, and don’t forget to add NoSlackPets: Lo-Fi Paws to your Wishlist if you haven’t already! 🐱💖

🎉 V1.0.5 Update (Released on August 1st, 2025) 
Thanks for your continued support! This week’s update brings many exciting new features and optimizations. Here’s what’s new:
🆕 New Features
Pool Party Feature: Relax in the pool with soothing music and white noise! Want to join a pool party with friends? ( >^ω^< )

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/17f3c8432bd1ad1c918b576ee80c1471898eb982.png"]

New Decorations: Added 8 new lights and 5 new doorframes. Feel the warmth when you light them up!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/febc952c55d7f54bf1d6067b7ac98710df1befa1.png"]

System Tray Icon: You can now access quick operations through the right-click menu in the system tray!

Pomodoro Timer Customization: Choose your preferred theme and ringtone for Pomodoro sessions to match your mood!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/3b26f100d04b60e55c205b0aee84ef2dbbceeb57.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/2163f1162e85cecbba3ba141be91c86b345b65b1.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/1424891bcef89e363061068ac6ef4c7d3caa9415.gif"]

System Taskbar Support: Music player, white noise, and Pomodoro timer now display in the system taskbar for easier access!
🔧 Optimizations
Reset Floor Decorations: Easily adjust your house decorations with the reset feature!

Improved Dragging Detection in Free Mode: Cats move more naturally with the updated dragging detection system.

Taskbar Icon Display: Now displays in game mode for easier access!

Music Shuffle Algorithm Optimization: Avoids repeated tracks under certain conditions!

Hotkey Optimization: F1, F4, and F12 hotkeys now work even when the game window is not focused!

Scene Lighting Optimizations: Nighttime scene lighting is now softer and more pleasant.

Pool Party Camera Adjustments: Adjust the camera height to see more cats during pool parties!

Improved Cat House Drag Collision Detection: Dragging experience is smoother!

Gift Box Animation Sound Effects: Added sound effects when opening gift boxes for a more interactive experience!
🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where imported local music would play incorrectly.

Fixed the music player being obscured by the taskbar.

Fixed an issue where the cat in Free Mode didn’t reach for the left side of the screen.

Fixed an issue with some scene decorations not being draggable.

Fixed incorrect music playlist order when playing favorites.

Fixed the issue where pressing multiple keys and then one more would cause the counter to add N+1.
